content: BCALM2 counting=modified DSK (GATB) with bucket partitioning matching its minimizer compaction stage; parallel bucket compaction then reunite; doesnt strictly honor -max-memory. DSK disk-based very low mem (6GB) but slow (4200-6500s); one of only two tools (with KMC3) accurate at k=28 and k=55 in GigaScience benchmark. Turtle had correctness bugs + aTurtle std::bad_alloc on human data (not a reliability reference). Confirms minimizer-bucket counting is proven reusable.
